itineraries.title: Five days from Lerici
itineraries.intro: The Gulf of Poets and the Cinque Terre from the east.

days.note: The castle over the Gulf of Poets; anchor in the bay for the evening.
The church of San Pietro on its rock, and the grotto Byron swam from.
The Cinque Terre from the water, then the harbour tower and a swim beneath the village.
The Bay of Silence at dusk; the old town’s seafront trattorie.
The piazzetta and the lighthouse walk; an evening at anchor off the harbour.

itineraries.title: Seven days from Genoa to Lerici
itineraries.intro: A slow Ligurian week: Portofino’s bay, the Cinque Terre and the Gulf of Poets.

days.note: Board in the old port; the palazzi of Via Garibaldi before the first crossing.
The fishing harbour and Punta Chiappa.
The abbey in its cove; the Christ of the Abyss.
The piazzetta, Castello Brown and the lighthouse walk.
The Bay of Silence at dusk; the old town’s seafront trattorie.
The Cinque Terre villages from the sea.
Portovenere and the Gulf of Poets; disembark in Lerici.
